name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: Your next days of events with the current one tagged: join the call, open it in Calendar, copy its details, delete it; a form adds one, or one typed line (`standup tomorrow 10:00`). EventKit on macOS, khal on Linux.
author: pal

settings.label: Source
settings.description: Where the events come from. Auto is Google once an account is listed below, else the system calendar (EventKit on macOS, khal on Linux).

settings.label: Google accounts
settings.description: One per line as `name = command`: the command prints an access token for the Calendar API (a bare token, or the JSON of an OAuth endpoint with access_token and expires_in). The command owns the secret; pal keeps the token in memory until it expires. In the config file an entry may be a table { name, token_command, calendars } to read calendars other than the primary.

settings.label: Calendars
settings.description: Calendar names (or ids) to show; empty shows every calendar. The filter dropdown narrows further.

settings.label: Days ahead
settings.description: How many days from today My Schedule lists.

settings.label: Bar horizon
settings.description: The bar item shows the next event only when it starts within this many hours; nothing sooner, no item.

settings.label: Near from
settings.description: Inside this many minutes, Upcoming uses its near appearance. Warning and critical cutoffs below still take precedence.

settings.label: Warning from
settings.description: The bar item uses its warning appearance this many minutes before the event.

settings.label: Critical from
settings.description: The bar item uses its critical appearance this many minutes before the event.

settings.label: Far colour
settings.description: The item colour outside the near window, but still inside the bar horizon.

settings.label: Near colour
settings.description: The item colour after Near from, before the warning cutoff.

settings.label: Warning colour
settings.description: The item colour from Warning from until the critical cutoff.

settings.label: Critical colour
settings.description: The item colour from Critical from until the event starts.

settings.label: Running colour
settings.description: The item colour while the event is under way.

settings.label: Far size
settings.description: Point size outside the near window. Zero keeps the item's normal Bar appearance.

settings.label: Near size
settings.description: Point size from Near from until warning. Zero keeps the item's normal Bar appearance.

settings.label: Attention size
settings.description: Point size while warning, critical or running. Zero keeps the item's normal Bar appearance.

settings.label: Far position
settings.description: A sketchybar position outside the near window, such as left or right. Empty keeps the item's Bar settings position.

settings.label: Near position
settings.description: A sketchybar position after Near from, before warning. Empty keeps the item's Bar settings position.

settings.label: Attention position
settings.description: A sketchybar position while warning, critical or running, such as q. Empty keeps the item's Bar settings position.

settings.label: Skip all-day events on the bar
settings.text: The bar item speaks for timed events only

settings.label: Quick Add length
settings.description: How long an event typed without an end or a `for` lasts.

store.tagline: Today at a glance, one key to join the call
features: Today: the day's events in order with the time and how long, each tagged `in 12 min`, `now, 25 min left` or `over`; tomorrow's once today is done; the next event's day when the day is clear
My Schedule: Today, Tomorrow, This week and Later as sections; the current event tagged `now`, the next one `in 12 min`

The bar item: the next event as `Standup in 12m` on the menu bar or sketchybar, `now` while it runs, hidden when nothing starts within 10 hours; muted far off, amber inside 15 minutes, red inside 5; a dot when there is a call. A click joins it, or opens Calendar; a hover peek opens Today

Three sources: every account Calendar.app has (iCloud, Google, Exchange) through EventKit on macOS; `khal` on Linux; Google Calendar directly, per account, through a command that prints an access token (`gcloud auth application-default print-access-token`, a broker, a keychain lookup), so no secret ever sits in the config
`enter` joins the call when the event has a Zoom, Meet, Teams or Webex link (Google's conferenceData first, then the location and the description), else opens it in Calendar or Google Calendar
The calendar's colour on the row, the head count and a `Join` tag on the right; a filter per calendar
The detail pane: the description as text, when, where, the organizer, every attendee with their reply, whether it repeats
New event as a form (system calendar): title, a day in words (`fri`, `next mon`, `20 sep`), start and end, all-day, the calendar, a location, notes

Quick Add Event: one line parsed as you type, `standup tomorrow 10:00`, `dentist fri 2pm-3pm`, `lunch 12:30 for 45m at Rest`, `retro next tue 3pm @ Work`, `birthday 20 sep` (all day); Enter adds it; a root query nothing matched offers it as a fallback row
Delete an event, or one occurrence of a repeating one, after a confirmation (system calendar)
Live with a 60 s ttl; the bar fetches every five minutes and on wake, renders from its cache on the minute

today.title: Today
today.description: The day's events in order with the time, how long, and where each stands (`in 12 min`, `now, 25 min left`, `over`); tomorrow's once today is done; what the bar item opens.

keys.title: Join the call, else open in Calendar
Details: the description, the attendees with their replies, the link

quick.title: Quick Add Event
quick.description: One line into an event: a title, then a day (`tomorrow`, `fri`, `next tue`, `20 sep`, `2026-09-20`), a time or a range (`10:00`, `2pm-3pm`, `14:00 to 15:30`), `for 45m`, `at <place>`, `@ <calendar>` (or `in <calendar>` when one starts with the word), `all day`. No time: all day; no day: today, or tomorrow once the time has passed. The row shows the event read back as you type; Enter adds it. At the root a query nothing matched gets an Add fallback row.

upcoming.title: Upcoming
upcoming.description: The next event's name with `in 12m` beside it, `25m left` while it runs (and `in 8m` for the one due next); hidden when nothing starts within the horizon; far, near, warning, critical and running appearances are configurable, a dot when there is a call to join. A click joins the call, or opens Calendar; a hover peek opens the day with Join on the calls, the running event on a card, tomorrow folded.
